release_notes: v9.8.37 (alterid-gated-full-sync) — Performance release. Full-sync now honours Tally's $$LastAlterId counter the same way the 5-min quick-sync has since v9.8.23. If nothing changed in Tally since the last successful full sync, the ENTIRE cycle is skipped (not just vouchers) — AlterID covers masters AND vouchers so this is safe. Default full-sync interval raised 20 → 60 min (quick 5-min sync is the fine-grained safety net). Safety guards: first-ever sync still runs; user-triggered Resync still runs AND drops the AlterID baseline so it can't be short-circuited; AlterID detection failure falls through to a normal full sync; partial syncs (any failed phase) do NOT save the baseline so recovery is attempted next cycle. Krishna Sales Corp impact: ~72 full-syncs/day → ~24 scheduled checks/day, most instant. First sync still ~17 min for 20k+ vouchers across 2 FYs. Voucher fetch path and multi-company safety preflight are byte-identical to v9.8.36 — zero risk of re-introducing the v9.8.35 doom-loop. Rebuild via `build-kit\build.bat`.
